flag_rule: ArcticGRO flag A (certified) is measured, P is provisional, and a blank flag, which the metadata does not explain, is provisional.
notes: Daily mean flow measured by Roshydromet at Kyusyur (station 3821), published by ArcticGRO in Lena_Kyusyur_Version_20260810.xlsx (ArcticGRO Discharge Dataset, Version 20260810).

Flow at these Russian gauges is computed from the water level through stage-discharge relations (rating curves), with winter correction coefficients that depend on water level and ice thickness; this is how the Arctic and Antarctic Research Institute (AARI) estimates the provisional values (ArcticGRO discharge metadata). The metadata does not describe the method for certified values.
Winter flows depend on correction coefficients for ice, and provisional winter values are updated at the end of ice conditions in June or July (ArcticGRO discharge metadata).
Flags on the days kept: {'A': 29641, 'P': 3060}. Years by flag: {'A': '1936 to 2021', 'P': '2012 to 2026'} (ArcticGRO).
"A" is certified by Roshydromet (measured here) and "P" provisional (ArcticGRO discharge metadata).
Values are published to about three significant figures (ArcticGRO).

Provisional days in years up to the last certified year (2021), by year: {'2012': 366, '2013': 365, '2015': 365, '2016': 126, '2017': 118, '2018': 128, '2019': 126, '2020': 134}. In years that mix both flags (2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020), the provisional days fall mostly in months ['06', '07', '08', '09', '10'] (ArcticGRO).
The ArcticGRO sampling site on the Lena is not at Kyusyur; ArcticGRO gives discharge for the station closest to it (ArcticGRO discharge metadata).
